Geographies Served Programs Kalika Kendra (Free Learning Center – FLC) Programme District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Abhyudaya currently supports over 4,000 socially deprived children through 100+ Kalika Kendras (Free Learning Centers – FLCs) across Bengaluru. Supervised by 135 local teachers and 25 mentors, these FLCs engage primary and high school students from government schools for two hours daily, providing academic assistance, homework support, and encouraging participation in extracurricular activities. The program emphasizes holistic development, including quiz competitions, sports, cultural activities, counselling sessions on personal hygiene and community health, workshops on values and ethics, as well as educational and recreational tours. Teachers undergo regular training to enhance their content knowledge, teaching methods, and interpersonal skills. Janagiri and Vidyanidhi Programme District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Jnanagiri offers free coaching for Grade X (SSLC) students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, providing Personality Development and Career Counseling sessions on weekends. Over 250 students annually benefit from this programme, with some progressing to professional studies and becoming valuable resources for Jnanagiri activities. Vidyanidhi is an effort to financially support academically bright children from low-income families, disbursing funds once a year to cover school fees, conveyance, uniforms, and stationery. The selection process involves meticulous verification by volunteers before finalizing recipients from Kalika Kendras and selected schools and colleges in Bengaluru. Milestones & Track Record As of June 2024, Abhyudaya has benefited 50,000 students through Kalika Kendra, provided scholarships to 8,500 beneficiaries through Vidyanidhi, coached 3,500 students through Jnanagiri, and impacted 8,000 beneficiaries through STEM Lab programs. --> --> Leadership Team Sri Lakshminarayana Executive Member Manish K Project Manager Sanjeev Koushik Member Anuradha Joshi Executive Member Sowmya Keshav Executive Member Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAATK1146K Registration Number 58/1963-64 CSR Form 1 Not Available VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2018/0188905 --> 80G AAATK1146KF20217 12A AAATK1146KE20219 FCRA 094421789 About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 1963 Demographies Served Women Children --> Impact Abhyudaya has helped school dropouts pursue professional courses, improved socio-economic status in communities, reduced crime in surrounding areas, and produced alumni who have become bank officers, state administrative cadre officers, and medical and engineering students. Vision and Mission Vision: Building a strong nation by empowering socially deprived sections of society through education. Mission: Complementing mainstream education system and inculcating Bharathiya values to underprivileged children through collaborative volunteerism.
